messages.en:
{07 16 00}You know, {01 00 00 05 00}my cold was so
bad, I thought I was gonna
KEEL OVER, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}But thanks to {ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}'s
{ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00}, I'm TOTALLY
recovered!
{07 06 00}WHEW!{01 00 00 05 00} I thought I would have
to, like, put corks in my
nose or something!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Tead, {01 00 00 05 00}mu külmetus oli nii

VAJUN KOKKU, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Aga tänu {ff 00 00 05}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}
{ff 00 00 07}rohule{ff 00 00 00} olen ma TÄIESTI

{07 06 00}UHH!{01 00 00 05 00} Ma arvasin, et pean,
nagu, korgid ninna
panema või nii!
